entities.summary: Peter Dajnko was a Slovene priest, author, and linguist, known primarily as the inventor of the Dajnko alphabet, an innovative proposal for the Slovene alphabet. Dajnko was also a proficient beekeeper and wrote the first book about beekeeping in Slovene, titled Čelarstvo (Beekeeping).
